semanticChecks: Cerebral vessel blockage/infarction versus rupture/hemorrhage, effect by damaged site/extent and no disease-name-only capacity assumptions retained.

Angina transient myocardial flow insufficiency versus infarction obstructed flow/myocardial damage and cell/tissue necrosis retained; pain severity alone never allows care-worker differential diagnosis. Hypertension/diabetes/coronary background and explicit medical-staff diagnostic/treatment confirmation retained.

Heart failure reduced pumping and breathlessness/palpitations/easy fatigue/edema/weight gain/urine change are clues, not one-symptom diagnosis. Cerebrovascular headache/dizziness/nausea/vomiting/consciousness/sensation/respiration signs are nonspecific.

Sudden paralysis/speech abnormality/dyspnea/severe chest pain requires emergency help/notification without delay or waiting to confirm cause. Long-term salt/fluid/activity management is separate from initial acute response.

Posture illustration is never forced universal instruction. Resident condition/distress, medical instructions and individual plan guide tolerable posture; adjustment does not prove recovery. Disease name never authorizes reducing drinking/continuing exercise. Observation time/resident words/baseline difference/actions are explicitly passed to medical staff.

Pneumonia bacterial/viral inflammation and fever/fatigue/appetite/cough/sputum clues retain atypical elderly presentation. Dysphagia differs from aspiration; not all swallowing disorder is aspiration.

Food/drink and bacteria-containing saliva may enter airway and lead to aspiration pneumonia. No observed choking or obvious cough never guarantees no aspiration. Oral hygiene and appropriate posture/food form manage risk, never guarantee full prevention.

Swallowing condition/evaluation confirmed with named nurse and speech/hearing therapist roles. Immediate lying-down idea stays individualized. Abnormal dyspnea/choking/voice/expression means stop feeding assistance and use facility help/reporting method, never continue feeding to test or independently alter drink/posture/food form. No diagnostic/swallow-test/drug/emergency technique instructions invented.

Persistent hyperglycemia, insulin glucose-utilization role and type1 mainly immune damage to pancreatic insulin-producing cells retained. Type1 more common children/young yet possible any age; older age never proves type2. Medical-staff confirmed diagnosis remains explicit.

Type2 insulin resistance and insufficient secretion retain multiple/lifestyle factors, no overeating-only blame. Thirst/increased drinking/polyuria/fatigue/unexplained weight loss may occur yet symptoms may be few. Measurement/treatment follows designated plan/responsibility; no independent food/activity/drug amount/type decisions.

Retinal/renal/peripheral nerve complications separate and medical cooperation retained. Reduced sensation and poor wound healing mean no pain never proves no wound/safety. Location/appearance/sensation/time reported per facility plan; no omitted record or self-applied medicine concealing course.

Diet/activity/medicine integrated in own treatment plan, satisfaction/preferences heard, no extra restriction or dose change; difficulties go to responsible person. Wound diagnosis/treatment not taught.

Congenital/disease/accident/aging visual causes, acuity versus field and varied seeing retained. Central scotoma may spare periphery; enlargement helps some without restoring lost field. Hemispatial neglect concerns brain attention, not same as field loss, may coexist and requires separate assessment.

Single tray-side omission never establishes cause/support. Ask resident seeing, adjust object position/light/text/explanation per assessment/preference, preserve cues without unauthorized relocation. Black diagram is not actual individual field or staff diagnosis.

Pacemaker individual instructions protect implant site from strong impact; device alone never bans all activity or permits settings changes. Hemodialysis external flow/removal of unwanted matter/some excess water/return and protecting vascular route retained.

Access-arm load/bathing day+method/salt+fluid follow individualized treatment-team instructions, no universal dialysis-day bathing ban or fluid restriction from table. Bleeding/swelling abnormalities promptly reported via designated method.

Portable oxygen cylinder/concentrator differs from ventilation support. Oxygen supports combustion and fire/burn danger; prescribed flow/settings unchanged. Fire/infection/power/supply interruption preparations and backup power/source depend on particular device and facility/home plan.

Stoma is abdominal opening for stool/urine, location/mechanism differ and not all bladder impairment has stoma. Appliance/waste handling follows plan+training; redness/erosion/leakage/baseline change reported, inexperienced staff never adjust appliance/opening by own method. Text alone never authorizes dialysis/oxygen/pacemaker/stoma operation/procedure.

Intellectual developmental/adaptive difficulties differ from mental illness. Adult dignity, life history/current life stage/preferences and strengths/choices retained; no infantilization for slower understanding.

Schizophrenia/mood disorders differ; severe phases may affect judgment/behavior regulation, never disease-label-only always incapable/dangerous assumption. Current state and individual support plan retained.
Depressive low mood/interest versus manic elevated mood/activity distinguished; one quiet/talkative/happy conversation never diagnosis. Actual baseline difference/time/distress communicated.

Hallucination absent corresponding external stimulus, delusion firm conviction despite reality mismatch, auditory hallucination subtype and professional evaluation retained. Accepting fear/distress differs from affirming content as fact. No arguing down/ignoring by label; calm needs assessment/support and facility emergency response if acute safety threat, not drug adjustment guide.

All28specific rationales retain their distinct source explanations. IDs/order/revisions/correctIndices/parallel arrays intact; all7readingkeys explicit empty,0absent/nonempty and0sectioncaptions. Prior01–12 byte-identical.
